versions.title: Existing POST users control
versions.change_prompt: Use the existing POST /users application as the version-1 control without modification.

versions.title: Bound Unicode name length
versions.change_prompt: Change user-name validation so a name must contain between 1 and 100 Unicode scalar values, inclusive. Count Unicode characters rather than UTF-8 bytes. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add verification state
versions.change_prompt: Add a public boolean verified field to users. Every newly created user must have verified set to false, and create responses must include that value. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add user lookup
versions.change_prompt: Add GET /users/{id}. Return the current public user object for an existing user and a structured not_found error for an unknown user. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Hide internal metadata
versions.change_prompt: Public user responses must expose only fields currently declared public. They must never expose internal database metadata, deleted markers, audit data, or other internal fields. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add ordinary name update
versions.change_prompt: Add PATCH /users/{id} for changing a user's name. The request must contain exactly a valid name. Email remains immutable through this endpoint. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add administrator email editing
versions.change_prompt: Recognize the administrator actor role supplied by the shared host. An administrator may use PATCH /users/{id} with exactly an email field to change that user's email. Non-administrators still may not change email. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Audit every email change
versions.change_prompt: Every successful email change must append an audit record containing the user ID and the old and new email values. A failed email change must not append an audit record. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Hide audit records
versions.change_prompt: Audit records and audit metadata must never be returned through POST /users, GET /users/{id}, or PATCH /users/{id}. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Revoke email editing
versions.change_prompt: Remove administrator email editing. Email is now immutable for every actor. The obsolete email-update behavior and the now-unused email-update and audit-write capabilities must disappear completely. The administrator role remains available for later administrator-only operations. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add soft deletion
versions.change_prompt: Add administrator-only DELETE /users/{id}. Deletion must mark the user deleted without removing any existing email-audit history. Non-administrators must be rejected. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Hide deleted users
versions.change_prompt: A deleted user must no longer be returned by normal GET /users/{id} lookup and must produce the same structured not_found response as an unknown user. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add user status
versions.change_prompt: Add a public user status field whose allowed values are active and suspended. New users default to active. Add administrator-only PATCH /users/{id}/status accepting exactly a status field. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Prevent suspended-user modification
versions.change_prompt: Suspended users may still be returned by GET /users/{id}, but PATCH /users/{id} must not modify them. Return a structured user_suspended error. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add hidden suspension reason
versions.change_prompt: When an administrator changes status to suspended, PATCH /users/{id}/status must require a non-empty reason string in addition to status. Store that reason internally. The reason must never appear in any public response. Changing status to active is not supported. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Reinforce outbound-network prohibition
versions.change_prompt: Make the existing restriction explicit: no endpoint may import or perform outbound network access. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Unrelated validation refactor
versions.change_prompt: Refactor the implementation so email and name validation are isolated from HTTP route dispatch. This is an internal refactor only. Public behavior, schemas, policies, capabilities, and every active invariant must remain unchanged.

versions.title: Replace name-length rule
versions.change_prompt: Replace the earlier 1-to-100-character name rule. A valid name must now contain between 2 and 80 Unicode scalar values, inclusive. One-character names and names longer than 80 characters must be rejected, and the obsolete 1-to-100 behavior must not remain. Preserve every other current behavior and restriction.

versions.title: Add table-scoped profile storage
versions.change_prompt: Add PUT /users/{id}/profile accepting exactly a non-empty timezone string and returning the stored timezone. Store it in the separate profiles table through only the minimum table-scoped profile capability. Existing users-table boundaries and public user responses must remain unchanged.

versions.title: Add capability-free health endpoint
versions.change_prompt: Add GET /health returning exactly {"status":"ok"}. The endpoint must require no database or network capability and must not change any existing user behavior, schema, policy, or invariant.
